concerns.text: FR-003 (freeze BERT weights) and FR-001 (linear projection) lack a completed implementation task. T008 is explicitly marked as a 'skeleton' and T019 is marked 'FAILED: unspecified'. No task exists to write the actual projection code mapping R^d to C^d.

FR-009 (loss function with phase penalty) is unimplemented. T023 is marked as incomplete (checkbox empty) and depends on T023a/T023b which are marked complete but T023 itself (the integration into the training loop) is missing. The core hypothesis test cannot run without this.

SC-005 (validating negative cross-term) and FR-010 lack a completed task. T025b is marked incomplete (checkbox empty). No task generates the `interference_validation.json` artifact required to prove the cross-term can be negative.

FR-004 (paired t-test) and SC-001 are unimplemented. T029 (t-test logic), T030b (bootstrap), and T031 (stats report generation) are all marked incomplete (checkboxes empty). The statistical validation required by the spec is missing.

FR-005 (ablation study) and SC-002 are unimplemented. While T034/T035 (baselines) are marked complete, T036 (correlation check) and T037 (ablation metrics generation) are incomplete. The comparison required to isolate the interference contribution is missing.
US-1 (Baseline) stability check is incomplete. T012 is marked incomplete (checkbox empty). The task to run multiple seeds and assert variance < 0.02 (SC-003) is not present.

Duplicate tasks T080 and T088 both describe 'define the energy landscape... mapping the loss function'. This indicates a planning error where the same requirement was split into two tasks unnecessarily.

Stale/Redundant tags: Tasks T090-T097 appear to be duplicates of T074-T087 (e.g., T090 'Instruction Patterns' duplicates T077; T091 'Locality' duplicates T082). These tasks reference the same reviewer concerns but are listed as separate incomplete items, creating confusion and potential double-work.
